senses.gloss:
जिन जिन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. जि), victorious,
triumphant; (अस्), m. ‘the overcomer of all things,’
a generic term applied to a Buddha or chief saint of
the Bauddha sect in the same manner as to a Jaina
saint; a N. applied to an Arhat who is a kind of
sovereign pontiff or saint of the Jainas and regarded
by them as superior to the gods of other sects;
(twenty-four Jinas are supposed to flourish in each
of the three Ava-sarpiṇīs or Jaina ages, past, present,
and to come, making seventy-two in all; they are
all born in Āryāvarta); N. of a Bodhi-sattva; an
epithet of Viṣṇu; any very old man; [cf. जीन and
जीर्न.]
—जिन-त्रात or जिन-दत्त or जिन-पुत्र,
अस्, or जिन-बन्धु, उस्, m., N. of various persons
mentioned in Buddhist writings.
—जिन-धर्म,
अस्, m., N. of a Jaina work.
—जिन-भक्ति-सूरि, इस्,
m., N. of a preceptor of Jina-lābha-sūri.
—जिन-
मित्र, अस्, m., N. of one of the translators of the
Lalita-vistara.
—जिन-लाभ-सूरि, इस्, m., N. of a
pupil of Jina-bhakti-sūri and preceptor of Kṣamā-
kalyāṇa.
—जिन-वक्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
—जिन-श्री, ईस्, m., N. of a king.
—जिन-सद्मन्,
अ, n. a Jaina temple or monastery.
—जिन-सेन, अस्,
m., N. of the author of the work Triṣaṣṭi-lakṣaṇa-
mahāpurāṇa-saṅgraha.
—जिनाङ्कुर (˚न-अङ्˚), अस्,
m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—जिनाधार (˚न-आध्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—जिनेन्द्र (˚न-इन्˚),
अस्, m. a Jaina saint, a Buddha; N. of a grammarian.
—जिनेन्द्र-न्यास, अस्, m. title of the work of
Jinendra-buddhi.
—जिनेन्द्र-बुद्धि or जिनेन्द्र-
भूति, इस्, m., N. of a writer on grammar.
—जिने-
श्वर (˚न-ईश्˚), अस्, m. an Arhat of the Jainas; N.
of the twentieth Arhat of the past Ut-sarpiṇī.
—जि-
नोत्तम (˚न-उत्˚), अस्, m. an Arhat of the Jainas.
—जिनोरस (˚न-उर्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-
sattva.
जीन, अस्, आ, अम्, old, aged; a leather bag.

जिनयोनि जिन-योनि, इस्, m. (for अजिन-योनि,
q. v.), a deer.
जिन्दुराज जिन्दु-राज, अस्, m., N. of a man.

जिन्व् जिन्व् (connected with जीव् and जू ?),
cl. 1. P., Ved. जिन्वति, जिजिन्व, जिन्वि-
ष्यति, जिन्वितुम्, to move one's self, be active or
lively; to urge on, cause to move quickly, impel, in-
cite, excite; to refresh, animate; to promote, help,
favour; to help any one (acc.) to anything (dat.),
cause to obtain, grant, confer; to please, satisfy,
[]
gladden, gratify, make happy or contented; to re-
ceive favourably (a request &c.): cl. 10. P. जिन्व-
यति, a various reading for जुञ्च्.
जिन्व, अस्, आ, अम्, in धियञ्-जिन्व, q. v.
